description:
Free open-source software to boost sound quality, volume, and bass. Including an equalizer, effects, and presets for customized audio.


1. Fixed installer launching FxSound with admin privileges after installation (#589)
2. Fixed volume muting unexpectedly when cycling through output devices with hotkeys, and volume jumping to full when switching back from a device that changed its own volume level (#606, #607)
3. Fixed preset not following the correct row when a row is moved or a new row is added in the output device preference list
4. Fixed garbled text shown in the duplicate preset export prompt
5. Fixed memory leak caused by repeated reinitialization when no playback device is available
